_comment: Eval question set (10 fixed questions). Proposed set, editable before the run. Q1 is the baseline anchor, kept for continuity. All are citation-demanding research questions in the operations domain.

questions.text: What are the credible, evidence-backed revenue opportunities for solo AI-agent operators in the next 12 months?
What are hiring managers screening for when evaluating AI engineers in late 2026, and which portfolio artifacts most influence their decisions?
What are the going rates and current demand for AI automation and AI-video services sold by solo operators on Fiverr and LinkedIn?
Which AI agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, others) are seeing the fastest enterprise adoption in 2026, and what evidence supports that?
What are the most common failure modes and mitigation strategies for production LLM agents as of 2026?
How are API pricing changes and model deprecations affecting independent AI developers, and what mitigation patterns reduce that risk?
Which regulated verticals (legal, medical, financial) offer the highest pricing power for AI implementation services, and what compliance barriers gate entry?
What is the current state of local/on-device LLM inference for 70B-class models on consumer and workstation hardware in 2026?
Which customer-acquisition channels deliver the best CAC and close rates for solo AI consultants, with supporting benchmarks?
What are the credible monthly revenue ranges for solo AI operators by stage (entry, growth, established), and how reliable is the underlying data?
